errors.text: The proposed Cr-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of intermediate-temperature aging in as-cast dual-phase AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
It misses the non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile response and instead predicts a generic monotonic toughness improvement.
The proposed mechanism omits L12 ordering, increased APBE, restricted cross-slip, planar slip, jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries, and crack initiation at phase-boundary tips.
The cited studies concern different alloy systems and do not demonstrate that Cr addition preserves toughness after the specified thermal exposure.
The proposed loading regime and toughness metric are not defined.
